card.name: Separators inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A comma or decimal point (or a digit) right after a leading digit, such as 4 or 7, inside a number. Seen in patient counts, trial sizes, percentages and phone numbers.

modes.label: Thousands comma
modes.description: The comma after the first digit of a number in the thousands, usually a patient or sample count.

modes.label: Decimal point
modes.description: The decimal point after a single digit in a percentage or rate.

modes.label: Digit in phone number
modes.description: A digit partway through a phone number.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese number and time words, so it weakly favors digit or numeral continuations.
card.plain: It marks the spot just after the first digit of a number, where a comma or decimal point comes before more digits.
